panels.title: Peak hours
panels.description: Distinct observers and raw fix count per hour. grafana/queries.sql #3.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    date_trunc('hour', recorded_at) AS time,
    count(DISTINCT observer_id) AS distinct_observers,
    count(*) AS fix_count
FROM fixes
WHERE $__timeFilter(recorded_at)
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time;

panels.title: Heatmap density (by grid cell)
panels.description: Grid cells weighted by fix confidence. grafana/queries.sql #1 — the same binning the live map's heatmap layer (applications/web) uses.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    round(x / 0.5) * 0.5 AS grid_x,
    round(y / 0.5) * 0.5 AS grid_y,
    count(*) AS fix_count,
    sum(1.0 / greatest(uncertainty_meters, 0.1)) AS weighted_density
FROM fixes
WHERE $__timeFilter(recorded_at)
GROUP BY grid_x, grid_y
ORDER BY weighted_density DESC;

panels.title: Occupancy (distinct observers by grid cell)
panels.description: How many different phones/stations were seen in each area — not raw fix count, so one phone sending often doesn't look like a crowd. grafana/queries.sql #2.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    round(x / 0.5) * 0.5 AS grid_x,
    round(y / 0.5) * 0.5 AS grid_y,
    count(DISTINCT observer_id) AS distinct_observers
FROM fixes
WHERE $__timeFilter(recorded_at)
GROUP BY grid_x, grid_y
ORDER BY distinct_observers DESC;

panels.title: Dwell time (seconds stopped, by grid cell)
panels.description: Inferred from consecutive fixes: time spent where an observer's position barely moved (< 0.5m) counts as dwelling there, not passing through. grafana/queries.sql #4.

targets.rawSql:
WITH ordered_fixes AS (
    SELECT
        observer_id,
        x,
        y,
        recorded_at,
        lag(x) OVER (PARTITION BY observer_id ORDER BY recorded_at) AS prev_x,
        lag(y) OVER (PARTITION BY observer_id ORDER BY recorded_at) AS prev_y,
        lag(recorded_at) OVER (PARTITION BY observer_id ORDER BY recorded_at) AS prev_time
    FROM fixes
    WHERE $__timeFilter(recorded_at)
),
movement AS (
    SELECT
        x,
        y,
        sqrt(power(x - prev_x, 2) + power(y - prev_y, 2)) AS distance_moved,
        extract(epoch FROM (recorded_at - prev_time)) AS seconds_elapsed
    FROM ordered_fixes
    WHERE prev_x IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    round(x / 0.5) * 0.5 AS grid_x,
    round(y / 0.5) * 0.5 AS grid_y,
    sum(CASE WHEN distance_moved < 0.5 THEN seconds_elapsed ELSE 0 END) AS dwell_seconds
FROM movement
GROUP BY grid_x, grid_y
ORDER BY dwell_seconds DESC;
